title.zh: 汇丰公布香港稳定币名称「HSBC RedCoin」并计划分阶段推出
title.en: HSBC Names Hong Kong Stablecoin 'RedCoin' and Plans Phased Rollout

current_state.zh: 汇丰的RedCoin稳定币已进入面向PayMe用户的分阶段推出阶段，首阶段支持P2P转账和商户支付，预计周末前全面可用，并计划年底前扩展至代币化货币市场基金认购。
current_state.en: HSBC's RedCoin stablecoin is now in phased rollout to PayMe users, with initial P2P transfers and merchant payments, expected full availability before the weekend, and planned expansion to tokenized money market fund subscriptions by year-end.

updates.title_zh: 【汇丰公布香港稳定币名称为「HSBC RedCoin」，计划分阶段推出】
updates.title_en: 【汇丰公布香港稳定币名称为「HSBC RedCoin」，计划分阶段推出】
updates.what_changed_zh: 汇丰银行将其即将推出的香港稳定币命名为HSBC RedCoin，并概述了分阶段推出的计划，先从P2P转账和商户支付开始，再扩展到企业和机构应用，并援引一项对1000多名本地客户的调查，显示稳定币认知度广泛。
updates.what_changed_en: HSBC named its upcoming Hong Kong stablecoin HSBC RedCoin and outlined a phased rollout starting with P2P transfers and merchant payments before expanding to corporate and institutional applications, citing a survey of over 1,000 local customers showing broad stablecoin awareness.

updates.title_zh: 汇丰RedCoin在香港推出前瞄准74%了解稳定币的用户
updates.title_en: HSBC RedCoin Targets 74% Stablecoin-Aware Users Ahead of Hong Kong Launch
updates.what_changed_zh: 汇丰银行正将其与港元挂钩的RedCoin稳定币定位为瞄准约74%了解稳定币的香港受访者，准备在该市新的发牌框架下推出。
updates.what_changed_en: HSBC is positioning its HKD-backed RedCoin stablecoin to target the roughly 74% of Hong Kong respondents aware of stablecoins ahead of an anticipated launch under the city's new licensing framework.

updates.title_zh: HSBC Launches HKD-Backed RedCoin Stablecoin for 3.3 Million PayMe Users in Hong
updates.title_en: HSBC Launches HKD-Backed RedCoin Stablecoin for 3.3 Million PayMe Users in Hong
updates.what_changed_zh: 汇丰已于10月23日开始向超过330万PayMe用户推出其获香港金管局发牌的港元挂钩RedCoin稳定币，首阶段支持P2P转账和商户支付，并计划年底前通过手机银行应用接入代币化货币市场基金认购。
updates.what_changed_en: HSBC began rolling out its HKMA-licensed HKD-backed RedCoin stablecoin to more than 3.3 million PayMe users on October 23, starting with P2P transfers and merchant payments and planning to add tokenized money market fund subscriptions via its mobile banking app by year-end.
updates.current_state_zh: 汇丰的RedCoin稳定币已进入面向PayMe用户的分阶段推出阶段，首阶段支持P2P转账和商户支付，预计周末前全面可用，并计划年底前扩展至代币化货币市场基金认购。
updates.current_state_en: HSBC's RedCoin stablecoin is now in phased rollout to PayMe users, with initial P2P transfers and merchant payments, expected full availability before the weekend, and planned expansion to tokenized money market fund subscriptions by year-end.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: HSBC began rolling out its HKMA-licensed, Hong Kong dollar-backed RedCoin stablecoin to more than 3.3 million PayMe users on October 23, starting with peer-to-peer and merchant payments and with plans to add tokenized money market fund subscriptions via its mobile banking app by year-end.
updates.detailed_summary_en: HSBC began rolling out its HKMA-licensed, Hong Kong dollar-backed RedCoin stablecoin to more than 3.3 million PayMe users on October 23, starting with peer-to-peer and merchant payments and with plans to add tokenized money market fund subscriptions via its mobile banking app by year-end.
